core_categories: Diabetes Supplies; Ostomy Supplies; Wound Care Supplies; Urology Supplies; Incontinence Supplies; Enteral Nutrition Products; Breast Pumps
specialty_focus: Byram Healthcare is a national home medical supply distributor delivering disposable medical products directly to patients managing chronic health conditions. It specializes in insurance verification, claims processing, and clinical support, with Centers of Excellence and WOCN-certified nurses. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices, though it distributes CGMs and insulin pumps which are wearable.
